messages.content: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to convert light energy into chemical energy they can use for fuel. Using chlorophyll in their leaves, they capture sunlight and combine carbon dioxide from the air with water from their roots to produce glucose (sugar) and release oxygen as a byproduct. This is why plants are essential to life on Earth—they create the oxygen we breathe while making food for themselves.
